changeSet.author: Arun
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE parking_slot ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, area VARCHAR(200), slot_number VARCHAR(200), status VARCHAR(200), user_id BIGINT, tenant_id BIGINT, created_by BIGINT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), updated_by BIGINT, updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ, is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE, FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id) REFERENCES tenant (id), FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES user (id) );

changeSet.author: Arun
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE vehicles ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, registrationNumber VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL UNIQUE, vehicleType VARCHAR(200), brand VARCHAR(200), model VARCHAR(200), owner_id BIGINT NOT NULL, created_by BIGINT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), updated_by BIGINT, updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ, is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE, FOREIGN KEY (owner_id) REFERENCES user (id) );

changeSet.author: Arun
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE parking_requests ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, user_id BIGINT, requested_slot_id BIGINT, status VARCHAR(200), adminComment VARCHAR(500) created_by BIGINT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), updated_by BIGINT, updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ, is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE, FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES user (id), FOREIGN KEY (requested_slot_id) REFERENCES parking_slot (id) );
